decisions.reason: A core track spotlight line with its own page for two years represents sunk development and visible commitment central to the firm's modular system direction, so management persists.
This established multi-model ceiling luminaire line has been shown consistently since 2023, and dropping it would contradict earlier investment and dealer display commitments.
Launched in 2024 as a multi-model line with its own page, any weak results can still be attributed to the early ramp-up, which justifies continued commitment.
The multi-outlet canopy complements the modular system the firm promotes and was only recently launched and visibly presented, so management keeps it.
The low-voltage canopy extends the system offer and is tied to the announced flexibility strategy, and its short time on the market allows disappointments to be seen as temporary.
Visibility is lower since it is only mentioned on the website, but the investment in a multi-model glass track line and its fit with the track system favour persistence.
